name: 180° Heavy-Duty Flipper
summary: Designed for flipping large or heavy products, achieving precise 180-degree rotation. It solves issues such as difficulty in manual flipping caused by process requirements.
contentHtml:
The 180-degree heavy-duty turnover machine is a core device developed by TXAM to meet the flipping needs of large and heavy products.

Working Principle

The equipment adopts a precision mechanical structure combined with a servo drive system to achieve one-click 180-degree flipping. The flipping process is smooth with precise positioning, effectively solving the difficulties and safety hazards of manual flipping.

Technical Advantages

  • Flipping cycle of 15-55 seconds, high efficiency
  • One-click operation, simple and convenient
  • Strong load capacity, suitable for large products such as TVs and educational displays
  • Multiple models available: TXM-B-105 series (A/B/C) and 205A
